sources.excerpt: Parvati by Demon Pedals | RockBoard | PedalPedia Skip to main content LOG IN EXPLORE Demon Pedals Parvati LOG IN TO SUGGEST IMPROVEMENTS OVERDRIVE FUZZ DISTORTION Description Based on the old Russian Muff by Matte, we have created a new edition of the legendary pedal, packed it into a smaller housing and equipped it with plenty of features to give it and you a wide range of sounds. A mid-range control has been added to better regulate these frequencies (scoop). Furthermore, each clipping stage has its own switch. The left switch (1st stage) allows you to switch between silicon - no clipping - germanium. The right switch (2nd stage) gives you three more clipping variants. If both switches are down, you get the clipping stages of the Green Muff. Everything else is up to you to find your personal tone! From fuzz/distortion to smooth overdrive, everything is included.
